name: compute-settings
title: A compute settings pane that loads, lists functions with their parameters, and saves
source: HitTriage's compute editor: B-3/N-2 (a table picker over grok.shell.tableNames with a nameless table open broke every pane), the unchecked function's pane made inert with no reason, a reasonless SAVE, its CSS reaching into u2 (hit-triage.css 128-210), and the rows built after an await into a pane already closed
notes: Graded strict (the engine throws on a misuse): the `item-null` of the nameless table throws while the table picker is built, so bad-shell-names fails every check that needs the built pane again; in production (report) it is skipped
